name: Alice to Yume no Kuni no Juunin-tachi
original_name: アリスと夢の国の住人たち
source: When the heroine wakes up in an unfamiliar place, she notices that she does not remember even her own name. There is a boy with rabbit ears before her, telling her that she won't be able to get back to her original place unless she completes the story. This is a story spun by people in the dream land and a girl.
